posts.name: drstein
posts.cooked:
""Christopher"":

Sorry about the $5 thing. We wanted to make it free to everyone, but printing a separate 41 card deck that’s not packaged with the game costs us more than we anticipated. Even with the $5, we’re still taking a loss on Unity, which is fine. We’re just trying to not make it a major loss.

Maybe this is a silly question but…you say it is a loss when printing the cards separately. How about adding her to the infernal relics expansion? The production costs of doing so are probably much smaller…and we get to enjoy one more hero for free

posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
That’s not at all a silly question! The issue there is three-fold:

First, we want to make her available to EVERYONE who might want her on the Kickstarter, and there are a group of people who are just pledging for the Enhanced Edition of Sentinels of the Multiverse that would not be able to get Unity as a result. We considered adding her to just the Enhanced Edition of Sentinels (because that solves for issues #2 and #3), but that runs into the opposite problem of not making her available to people just pledging for Infernal Relics/the Upgrade Mode package.

Second, she doesn’t really thematically fit with Infernal Relics, which may not be as huge of an issue to some, but that’s a big driving factor for us.

Lastly, and probably most importantly, it would actually create a TON more work for us to do so. Here’s why: anyone who has Rook City can tell you that, with the plastic insert in the box, there’s not room for another 41 hero cards. Were we to include another hero, we would have to make the Infernal Relics box bigger, which would mean a bigger insert, which, between all the changes that brings on, would cost significantly more than just doing a separate run of Unity.

So, I hope that helps give you an idea of where we are and why we are doing it this way. Thanks for your question!
